## Presentation

> Professor Lluís Pagès directs this part of the **society, family and education: educational processes and contexts** module called **educational framework**, which addresses how to join the Catalan educational system as a teacher, understanding the particular context that surrounds it and knowing how to interact with the various teams and social agents, to successfully fulfill the educational function. This implies knowing the main characteristics of the Catalan educational system and the particular center in which we join and knowing how to develop an effective task that contributes to educating students in a satisfactory manner. In addition, know the documentation and regulations and know how to take advantage of the various real cases worked on in the master's degree to resolve the challenges that arise in future incorporation into the educational system.
